question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Many'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **context** of the passage, the phrase "plants are very busy all the time doing (2) ______ things" suggests that the** blank requires an adjective** that describes the number or quantity of activities performed by plants.
 
• Among the given options,** "many" **is the correct choice.
 
• **"Many"** is an adjective that indicates a large number or a significant quantity of things.
 
• In this case, it** implies** that plants are engaged in numerous activities, emphasizing the variety and extent of their daily tasks.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *However, plants are very busy all the time doing **many** things. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of **other options**:

 
 
• **Any:** "Any" is not suitable in this context as it does not convey the idea of a large number or quantity of activities.
 
• **Very:** "Very" is an adverb that intensifies or emphasizes the degree or quality of something, but it does not convey the notion of a large number of activities.
 
• **Much:** "Much" is an adverb that indicates a large degree or quantity of something, but it does not convey the idea of a large number of activities.
